text: City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted this Item, and in so doing, has directed the Deputy City Manager, Internal Corporate Services and the Deputy City Manager, Cluster A to engage CreateTO as appropriate to provide Project Management Services during the construction phase, based on the summary statement of services set out in Attachment 4 to the report (April 3, 2018) from the Deputy City Manager, Internal Corporate Services, the Acting Deputy City Manager, Cluster A and the Interim Chief Financial Officer.

The Board of Directors of CreateTO recommends to the Executive Committee that: 1. City Council direct that the City's Environment and Energy Division be included in the consultation process for all real estate matters involving consultation with the City's agencies and divisions.
